articles.title: In 1961, British scientists stopped farming a 4-hectare barley field and left it alone; 60 years later...
articles.summary: A groundbreaking six-decade study reveals that passive rewilding effectively fosters the development of lush native woodlands. Through protective thorny scrub, young trees thrived, shielded from herbivores, while wind and jays ingeniously spread seeds, outlining the woodlands’ unique patterns.

articles.summary: The Bar Council of India has opened registration for AIBE XXII 2026, allowing eligible law graduates and candidates to apply online until October 27. The examination is scheduled for November 29, with admit cards expected from November 14.

articles.title: AIBE 21 registration begins at allindiabarexamination.com: Direct link to apply here
articles.summary: The Bar Council of India has commenced registration for AIBE XXII, with eligible law graduates able to apply until October 27, 2026. The application fee can be paid until October 28, while corrections remain open until October 30.

articles.title: IIT Bombay introduces new e-PG Diploma in Computer Science and AI with Generative AI and LLM modules
articles.summary: IIT Bombay ePG Diploma 2026: IIT Bombay has launched an e-Postgraduate Diploma in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence through its Educational Outreach initiative. The programme covers computer science, artificial intelligence and machine learning, including Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, computer vision and deep learning.

articles.title: NEET UG Counselling 2026: MCC revises Round 1 result date to August 21; check details here
articles.summary: The MCC has revised the NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 1 schedule, with seat allotment processing on August 19-20 and results scheduled for August 21. Candidates allotted seats must report and join by August 31.

articles.title: 'Awarapan 2' box office collection day 6: Emraan's film sees 16 percent drop on Wednesday
articles.summary: Awarapan 2 is proving to be a box office hit, amassing an impressive Rs 107.50 crore net across India by its sixth day. The film's take surged on Saturday, thanks to the holiday and extra screenings, though earnings saw a modest decline on Wednesday.

articles.title: ‘Batwara 1947’ box office collection day 6: Sunny's film likely to suffer loss of Rs 80 cr
articles.summary: Sunny Deol's historical drama 'Batwara 1947' has disappointed at the box office. The film collected only around Rs 32 crore net in India.

articles.title: Ravi Mohan files defamation case against 'Bro Club' producer
articles.summary: Actor Ravi Mohan has initiated legal proceedings against producer Shruthi Nallappa for defamation. The issue centers around unpaid dues connected to the film 'Bro Club.' Reports indicate that Nallappa reached out to Netflix and industry associations concerning these pending payments.

articles.title: After 'Ramayana', Ranbir to start 'Brahmastra 2' with Alia in April 2027
articles.summary: Director Ayan Mukerji and Ranbir Kapoor are gearing up for 'Brahmastra 2,' with the actor set to begin filming in April 2027 after wrapping 'Ramayana Part 2.' Alia Bhatt returns as Isha, while Deepika Padukone is reportedly in talks for a key role..
